chunks: From him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
Regarding a man who prepares for Ihram, it is permissible for him to have intercourse with women as long as he has not yet pronounced the Talbiyah or committed to it.

key_terms.إِحْرَام: The state of ritual consecration for Hajj or Umrah
key_terms.التَّلْبِيَة: The specific declaration of intent and praise of God to enter Ihram
key_terms.عَقَدَ: To conclude or commit to (in a legal/ritual context)
key_terms.يَأْتِيَ النِّسَاء: To have sexual intercourse with one's wife

ai.seo_question: When does the prohibition of sexual intercourse begin for a man entering Ihram?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Istibsar clarifies the precise temporal boundary for marital intimacy during Hajj preparation, distinguishing between the physical preparation phase and the formal ritual commitment marked by the Talbiyah. It reflects the Shia juristic view that the prohibitions of Ihram apply strictly from the moment of intention and declaration, allowing couples to maintain normal relations until that specific threshold is crossed.
